layers.deps: each mid task depends on two distinct root tasks
each final task depends on two distinct mid tasks

dag.note: fixed dependency-ready DAG; identical for both backends and all loads/seeds
dag.per_task: 1 gateway effect, 1 checkpoint with content hash, 1 transition + atomic audit/outbox event

load_levels.note: arrival counts are discrete task instances over the measured S1-002 envelope; they are research-station load levels, not production profiles

run_matrix.throughput_runs: backends x loads x seeds = 2 x 3 x 3 = 18
run_matrix.scenario_runs: 4 scenarios x 3 loads x 3 seeds x 2 backends = 72
run_matrix.independent_rerun: separate subprocess, separate output directory (run-b), same frozen manifest

fault_schedule.S4_lease_expiry_duplicate_delivery_stale: one stale owner attempt per scenario run

censoring: metrics that a backend cannot observe are recorded as explicit unavailable entries with reasons; they are never interpolated
coordinated_omission: the generator emits fixed arrival ticks from the frozen manifest; dispatch observations record arrival-to-dispatch for every task including late ones, so missing-data bias does not arise by construction
stop_conditions: run ends when all arrivals are processed or a terminal fault fires; failed/censored runs are recorded as failed, never silently retried
outcome_seed_policy: random.Random(seed) per run; no wall clock; no dict-order dependence
